2026/04/08 22:21:05 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- supabase/migrations/20260319000003_rbac_hierarchy.sql\n-- ============================================================================\n-- UNIFIED RBAC HIERARCHY (Levels 1-7)\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Function to get the numeric auth level of the current user\n-- Level 1: Super Admin\n-- Level 2: Admin Helper\n-- Level 3: Support Staff\n-- Level 4: Analyst\n-- Level 5: Station Owner\n-- Level 6: Station Supervisor\n-- Level 7: Station Operator\n-- Level 0/99: Public/Unauthenticated\n\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_auth_level()\nRETURNS INTEGER\nSECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public, auth\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n  f_uid TEXT := public.firebase_uid();\n  sys_role TEXT;\n  prof_role TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  -- 1. Check if user is in system_users (Levels 1-4)\n  SELECT role INTO sys_role FROM system_users WHERE firebase_uid = f_uid AND is_active = TRUE;\n  \n  IF sys_role IS NOT NULL THEN\n    CASE sys_role\n      WHEN 'super_admin' THEN RETURN 1;\n      WHEN 'admin_helper' THEN RETURN 2;\n      WHEN 'support_staff' THEN RETURN 3;\n      WHEN 'analyst' THEN RETURN 4;\n      ELSE RETURN 99;\n    END CASE;\n  END IF;\n\n  -- 2. Check if user is in profiles (Levels 5-7)\n  SELECT role INTO prof_role FROM profiles WHERE firebase_uid = f_uid;\n  \n  IF prof_role IS NOT NULL THEN\n    CASE prof_role\n      WHEN 'owner' THEN RETURN 5;\n      WHEN 'supervisor' THEN RETURN 6;\n      WHEN 'operator' THEN RETURN 7;\n      WHEN 'viewer' THEN RETURN 8; -- Extra level for read-only station view\n      ELSE RETURN 99;\n    END CASE;\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN 99; -- Unknown/Public\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:21:05 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_system_admin(required_level INTEGER DEFAULT 4)\nRETURNS BOOLEAN\nSECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public, auth\nAS $$\nBEGIN\n  -- Returns true if the user's level is less than or equal to the required system level (1-4)\n  -- Note: Lower number = higher priority\n  RETURN public.get_auth_level() \u003c= required_level AND public.get_auth_level() \u003e 0;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:21:05 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- Add a check for client-layer levels\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_client_access(required_level INTEGER DEFAULT 7)\nRETURNS BOOLEAN\nSECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public, auth\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n  u_level INTEGER := public.get_auth_level();\nBEGIN\n  -- System admins (1-4) have access to everything\n  IF u_level \u003c= 4 THEN\n    RETURN TRUE;\n  END IF;\n  \n  -- Client users (5-7) must have a level \u003c= required\n  RETURN u_level \u003c= required_level;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:21:06 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- 3. public.admin_adjust_client_debt\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_adjust_client_debt(\n  p_client_id UUID,\n  p_adjustment_amount DECIMAL,\n  p_reason TEXT\n) RETURNS JSONB\nSECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public, auth\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n  v_admin_uid TEXT;\n  v_system_user_id UUID;\n  v_old_debt DECIMAL;\n  v_new_debt DECIMAL;\n  v_transaction_id UUID;\n  v_fb_uid TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  v_admin_uid := public.firebase_uid();\n  \n  SELECT su.id INTO v_system_user_id\n  FROM public.system_users su\n  WHERE su.firebase_uid = v_admin_uid\n    AND su.is_active = TRUE\n    AND su.role IN ('super_admin', 'admin_helper');\n\n  IF v_system_user_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unauthorized: Only active Super Admins and Admin Helpers can adjust debt.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT cb.current_debt, cb.firebase_uid INTO v_old_debt, v_fb_uid\n  FROM public.client_billing cb WHERE cb.id = p_client_id;\n\n  IF v_old_debt IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Client not found.';\n  END IF;\n\n  v_new_debt := GREATEST(0, v_old_debt + p_adjustment_amount);\n  \n  UPDATE public.client_billing\n  SET current_debt = v_new_debt,\n      updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = p_client_id;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.transactions (\n    client_id, \n    firebase_uid, \n    transaction_type, \n    amount, \n    description, \n    payment_status,\n    created_by\n  ) VALUES (\n    p_client_id, \n    v_fb_uid, \n    'adjustment', \n    ABS(p_adjustment_amount), \n    p_reason, \n    'completed',\n    v_admin_uid\n  ) RETURNING id INTO v_transaction_id;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.admin_logs (\n    system_user_id,\n    firebase_uid,\n    action_type,\n    affected_client_id,\n    description,\n    changes_made\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_system_user_id,\n    v_admin_uid,\n    'debt_adjusted',\n    p_client_id,\n    'Manually adjusted debt: ' || p_reason,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'before', jsonb_build_object('current_debt', v_old_debt),\n      'after', jsonb_build_object('current_debt', v_new_debt),\n      'transaction_id', v_transaction_id\n    )\n  );\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'old_debt', v_old_debt,\n    'new_debt', v_new_debt\n  );\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:21:06 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- 4. public.admin_suspend_client\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_suspend_client(\n  p_client_id UUID,\n  p_reason TEXT\n) RETURNS JSONB\nSECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public, auth\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n  v_admin_uid TEXT;\n  v_system_user_id UUID;\n  v_old_status TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  v_admin_uid := public.firebase_uid();\n  \n  SELECT su.id INTO v_system_user_id\n  FROM public.system_users su\n  WHERE su.firebase_uid = v_admin_uid\n    AND su.is_active = TRUE\n    AND su.role IN ('super_admin', 'admin_helper');\n\n  IF v_system_user_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unauthorized: Only Super Admins and Admin Helpers can suspend accounts.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT account_status INTO v_old_status FROM public.client_billing WHERE id = p_client_id;\n  \n  UPDATE public.client_billing\n  SET account_status = 'suspended',\n      suspension_reason = p_reason,\n      updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = p_client_id;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.admin_logs (\n    system_user_id,\n    firebase_uid,\n    action_type,\n    affected_client_id,\n    description,\n    changes_made\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_system_user_id,\n    v_admin_uid,\n    'client_suspended',\n    p_client_id,\n    'Suspended account. Reason: ' || p_reason,\n    jsonb_build_object('before_status', v_old_status, 'after_status', 'suspended')\n  );\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true);\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:21:07 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- supabase/migrations/20260319000005_implement_org_rbac.sql\n-- ============================================================================\n-- ORG-BASED RBAC: Enable Station Supervisors \u0026 Operators to see data\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Function to get the client_id (Organization ID) for the current user\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_user_client_id()\nRETURNS UUID\nSECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public, auth\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n  f_uid TEXT := public.firebase_uid();\n  v_client_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  -- 1. 2026/04/08 22:21:14 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- supabase/migrations/20260319000008_rename_owner_to_admin.sql\n-- ============================================================================\n-- ROLE ALIAS: owner / admin (Client Web Layer)\n-- Station Owners are now formally referred to as 'admin', but 'owner' \n-- remains supported for backward compatibility and interchangeable use.\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Step 1: Update the constraint from profiles to allow BOTH\nALTER TABLE public.profiles\n  DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS profiles_role_check","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:21:14 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- Step 3: Update get_auth_level function to recognize both as Level 5\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_auth_level()\nRETURNS INTEGER\nSECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public, auth\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n  f_uid TEXT := public.firebase_uid();\n  sys_role TEXT;\n  prof_role TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  -- 1. Check if user is in system_users (Levels 1-4)\n  SELECT role INTO sys_role FROM system_users WHERE firebase_uid = f_uid AND is_active = TRUE;\n  \n  IF sys_role IS NOT NULL THEN\n    CASE sys_role\n      WHEN 'super_admin' THEN RETURN 1;\n      WHEN 'admin_helper' THEN RETURN 2;\n      WHEN 'support_staff' THEN RETURN 3;\n      WHEN 'analyst' THEN RETURN 4;\n      ELSE RETURN 99;\n    END CASE;\n  END IF;\n\n  -- 2. Check if user is in profiles (Levels 5-8)\n  SELECT role INTO prof_role FROM profiles WHERE firebase_uid = f_uid;\n  \n  IF prof_role IS NOT NULL THEN\n    CASE prof_role\n      WHEN 'admin' THEN RETURN 5;    -- Preferred\n      WHEN 'owner' THEN RETURN 5;    -- Alias\n      WHEN 'supervisor' THEN RETURN 6;\n      WHEN 'operator' THEN RETURN 7;\n      WHEN 'viewer' THEN RETURN 8;\n      ELSE RETURN 99;\n    END CASE;\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN 99; -- Unknown/Public\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:21:20 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- supabase/migrations/20260321000003_fix_firebase_uid_resolver.sql\n-- ============================================================================\n-- FIX: Restore x-firebase-uid header fallback in firebase_uid()\n-- Some components (like the Super Admin portal) send a custom header for RLS.\n-- The previous version only looked at JWT claims, leading to RLS failures if \n-- the JWT parsing was bypassed or if the header was preferred.\n-- ============================================================================\n\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.firebase_uid()\nRETURNS TEXT AS $$\nBEGIN\n  RETURN NULLIF(\n    COALESCE(\n      current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true)::json-\u003e\u003e'sub',\n      current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true)::json-\u003e\u003e'user_id',\n      current_setting('request.headers', true)::json-\u003e\u003e'x-firebase-uid'\n    ),\n    ''\n  );\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:21:26 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.firebase_uid()\nRETURNS TEXT AS $$\nDECLARE\n  native_uid UUID := auth.uid();\n  f_uid TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  -- If native Supabase Auth is present, return the native UID as text\n  IF native_uid IS NOT NULL THEN\n    RETURN native_uid::TEXT;\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Fallback to JWT claims or headers (for backward compatibility during migration)\n  RETURN NULLIF(\n    COALESCE(\n      current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true)::json-\u003e\u003e'sub',\n      current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true)::json-\u003e\u003e'user_id',\n      current_setting('request.headers', true)::json-\u003e\u003e'x-firebase-uid'\n    ),\n    ''\n  );\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, auth","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:21:26 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- 3. Update get_auth_level() to check both firebase_uid and supabase_uid\nDROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.get_auth_level() CASCADE","ParameterOIDs":null}
2026/04/08 22:21:26 PG Send: {"Type":"Bind","DestinationPortal":"","PreparedStatement":"","ParameterFormatCodes":null,"Parameters":[],"ResultFormatCodes":[]}

2026/04/08 22:21:26 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_auth_level()\nRETURNS INTEGER\nSECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public, auth\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n  f_uid TEXT := public.firebase_uid();\n  n_uid UUID := auth.uid();\n  sys_role TEXT;\n  prof_role TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  -- 1. Check if user is in system_users (Levels 1-4)\n  -- Check by native UUID first, then fallback to firebase_uid\n  SELECT role INTO sys_role \n  FROM system_users \n  WHERE (supabase_uid = n_uid OR firebase_uid = f_uid) \n  AND is_active = TRUE\n  LIMIT 1;\n  \n  IF sys_role IS NOT NULL THEN\n    CASE sys_role\n      WHEN 'super_admin' THEN RETURN 1;\n      WHEN 'admin_helper' THEN RETURN 2;\n      WHEN 'support_staff' THEN RETURN 3;\n      WHEN 'analyst' THEN RETURN 4;\n      ELSE RETURN 99;\n    END CASE;\n  END IF;\n\n  -- 2. Check if user is in profiles (Levels 5-7)\n  SELECT role INTO prof_role \n  FROM profiles \n  WHERE (supabase_uid = n_uid OR firebase_uid = f_uid)\n  LIMIT 1;\n  \n  IF prof_role IS NOT NULL THEN\n    CASE prof_role\n      WHEN 'owner' THEN RETURN 5;\n      WHEN 'supervisor' THEN RETURN 6;\n      WHEN 'operator' THEN RETURN 7;\n      WHEN 'viewer' THEN RETURN 8;\n      ELSE RETURN 99;\n    END CASE;\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN 99; -- Unknown/Public\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:21:26 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()\nRETURNS TRIGGER AS $$\nBEGIN\n  IF (NEW.raw_user_meta_data-\u003e\u003e'role') = 'system_admin' THEN\n    INSERT INTO public.system_users (supabase_uid, email, full_name, role, firebase_uid)\n    VALUES (\n      NEW.id, \n      NEW.email, \n      COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data-\u003e\u003e'full_name', NEW.email), \n      COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data-\u003e\u003e'admin_role', 'support_staff'),\n      'sb_' || NEW.id::TEXT -- Placeholder for firebase_uid compatibility\n    );\n  ELSE\n    INSERT INTO public.profiles (supabase_uid, email, display_name, role, firebase_uid)\n    VALUES (\n      NEW.id, \n      NEW.email, \n      COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data-\u003e\u003e'full_name', NEW.email), \n      COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data-\u003e\u003e'role', 'viewer'),\n      'sb_' || NEW.id::TEXT\n    );\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, auth","ParameterOIDs":null}

Helper function for the Super Admin to \"link\" existing Firebase accounts to Supabase\n-- This is useful if the user logs in with the same email and we want to transfer their data.\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.link_firebase_to_supabase(p_firebase_uid TEXT, p_supabase_uid UUID)\nRETURNS BOOLEAN\nSECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public, auth\nAS $$\nBEGIN\n  -- Update system_users\n  UPDATE public.system_users \n  SET supabase_uid = p_supabase_uid \n  WHERE firebase_uid = p_firebase_uid;\n  \n  -- Update profiles\n  UPDATE public.profiles \n  SET supabase_uid = p_supabase_uid \n  WHERE firebase_uid = p_firebase_uid;\n  \n  RETURN TRUE;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:21:29 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- 1. Link or Create the Super Admin in system_users\n-- system_users has UNIQUE(email) so ON CONFLICT works here\nDO $$\nBEGIN\n  -- Local dev can run before the auth user exists; avoid hard-failing `supabase start`.\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1\n    FROM information_schema.tables\n    WHERE table_schema = 'auth'\n      AND table_name = 'users'\n  )\n  AND EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1\n    FROM auth.users\n    WHERE id = '4d297d9b-c1a2-4bff-9399-8b0b20e88156'::uuid\n  ) THEN\n    IF EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1\n      FROM information_schema.columns\n      WHERE table_schema = 'public'\n        AND table_name = 'system_users'\n        AND column_name = 'firebase_uid'\n    ) THEN\n      INSERT INTO public.system_users (email, full_name, role, supabase_uid, firebase_uid, is_active)\n      VALUES (\n          'josezvundi@gmail.com',\n          'Joseph Vundi',\n          'super_admin',\n          '4d297d9b-c1a2-4bff-9399-8b0b20e88156',\n          'sb_4d297d9b-c1a2-4bff-9399-8b0b20e88156',\n          true\n      )\n      ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET\n          supabase_uid = EXCLUDED.supabase_uid,\n          firebase_uid = EXCLUDED.firebase_uid,\n          role = 'super_admin',\n          is_active = true;\n    ELSE\n      INSERT INTO public.system_users (email, full_name, role, supabase_uid, is_active)\n      VALUES (\n          'josezvundi@gmail.com',\n          'Joseph Vundi',\n          'super_admin',\n          '4d297d9b-c1a2-4bff-9399-8b0b20e88156',\n          true\n      )\n      ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET\n          supabase_uid = EXCLUDED.supabase_uid,\n          role = 'super_admin',\n          is_active = true;\n    END IF;\n  ELSE\n    RAISE NOTICE 'Skipping system_users super_admin link: auth.users record not present yet';\n  END IF;\nEND\n$$","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:21:29 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- 2. Link or Create the corresponding profile\n-- profiles might NOT have UNIQUE(email), so we use a DO block\nDO $$\nBEGIN\n    IF EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1\n      FROM information_schema.tables\n      WHERE table_schema = 'auth'\n        AND table_name = 'users'\n    )\n    AND EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1\n      FROM auth.users\n      WHERE id = '4d297d9b-c1a2-4bff-9399-8b0b20e88156'::uuid\n    ) THEN\n      IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles WHERE email = 'josezvundi@gmail.com') THEN\n          UPDATE public.profiles SET\n              supabase_uid = '4d297d9b-c1a2-4bff-9399-8b0b20e88156',\n              role = 'admin' -- Level 5 for client app access\n          WHERE email = 'josezvundi@gmail.com';\n      ELSE\n          IF EXISTS (\n            SELECT 1\n            FROM information_schema.columns\n            WHERE table_schema = 'public'\n              AND table_name = 'profiles'\n              AND column_name = 'firebase_uid'\n          ) THEN\n            INSERT INTO public.profiles (email, display_name, role, supabase_uid, firebase_uid)\n            VALUES (\n                'josezvundi@gmail.com',\n                'Joseph Vundi',\n                'admin',\n                '4d297d9b-c1a2-4bff-9399-8b0b20e88156',\n                'sb_4d297d9b-c1a2-4bff-9399-8b0b20e88156'\n            );\n          ELSE\n            INSERT INTO public.profiles (email, display_name, role, supabase_uid)\n            VALUES (\n                'josezvundi@gmail.com',\n                'Joseph Vundi',\n                'admin',\n                '4d297d9b-c1a2-4bff-9399-8b0b20e88156'\n            );\n          END IF;\n      END IF;\n    ELSE\n      RAISE NOTICE 'Skipping profiles super_admin link: auth.users record not present yet';\n    END IF;\nEND $$","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:21:33 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- 1. Modernize is_system_admin to support both native Supabase UID and Firebase UID\n-- This function is SECURITY DEFINER to bypass RLS when checking permissions.\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_system_admin(required_role TEXT DEFAULT NULL)\nRETURNS BOOLEAN\nSECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public, auth\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n  v_uid_text TEXT := public.firebase_uid();\n  v_uid_uuid UUID := auth.uid();\n  v_role TEXT;\n  v_active BOOLEAN;\n  v_role_order INT;\n  v_req_order INT;\nBEGIN\n  -- Basic validity check\n  IF v_uid_uuid IS NULL AND v_uid_text IS NULL THEN\n    RETURN FALSE;\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Fetch role and status bypassing RLS\n  SELECT su.role, su.is_active INTO v_role, v_active\n  FROM public.system_users su\n  WHERE (su.supabase_uid = v_uid_uuid OR su.firebase_uid = v_uid_text)\n  LIMIT 1;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND OR NOT v_active THEN\n    RETURN FALSE;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF required_role IS NULL THEN\n    RETURN TRUE;\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Numeric hierarchy for comparison\n  v_role_order := CASE v_role\n    WHEN 'super_admin'   THEN 4\n    WHEN 'admin_helper'  THEN 3\n    WHEN 'support_staff' THEN 2\n    WHEN 'analyst'       THEN 1\n    ELSE 0\n  END;\n\n  v_req_order := CASE required_role\n    WHEN 'super_admin'   THEN 4\n    WHEN 'admin_helper'  THEN 3\n    WHEN 'support_staff' THEN 2\n    WHEN 'analyst'       THEN 1\n    ELSE 0\n  END;\n\n  RETURN v_role_order \u003e= v_req_order;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:21:33 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- 2. Add an INTEGER overload for is_system_admin to support legacy level checks\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_system_admin(required_level INTEGER)\nRETURNS BOOLEAN\nSECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public, auth\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n  v_level INTEGER;\nBEGIN\n  v_level := public.get_auth_level();\n  -- Level mapping: 1=super, 2=helper, 3=staff, 4=analyst\n  -- Hierarchy is inverted (lower number = higher power)\n  RETURN v_level \u003c= required_level;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:21:36 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_client_dashboard_summary(p_supabase_uid UUID)\nRETURNS JSON AS $$\nDECLARE v_summary JSON;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT json_build_object(\n    'billing', (\n      SELECT json_build_object(\n        'current_debt', cb.current_debt,\n        'total_paid', cb.total_paid,\n        'subscription_tier', cb.subscription_tier,\n        'account_status', cb.account_status,\n        'next_billing_date', cb.next_billing_date\n      ) FROM public.client_billing cb WHERE cb.supabase_uid = p_supabase_uid\n    ),\n    'tanks', (\n      SELECT json_agg(\n        json_build_object(\n          'id', t.id, 'name', t.tank_name, 'fuel_type', t.fuel_type,\n          'current_volume', t.current_volume, 'capacity', t.tank_capacity,\n          'fill_percentage', ROUND((t.current_volume / NULLIF(t.tank_capacity, 0) * 100)::NUMERIC, 2),\n          'temperature', t.current_temperature, 'status', t.status\n        )\n      ) FROM public.tanks t WHERE t.supabase_uid = p_supabase_uid AND t.status = 'active'\n    ),\n    'unread_alerts', (\n      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.alerts a\n      WHERE a.supabase_uid = p_supabase_uid AND a.is_read = FALSE\n    ),\n    'critical_alerts', (\n      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.alerts a\n      WHERE a.supabase_uid = p_supabase_uid AND a.is_read = FALSE AND a.severity = 'critical'\n    )\n  ) INTO v_summary;\n  RETURN v_summary;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public","ParameterOIDs":null}
